`content/` bilingual: keep `_index.de.md`/`_index.en.md` siblings with mirrored, synced YAML (`title`, `date`, `draft`, `weight`, `archetype`; ISO timestamps). Extend `layouts/partials/`/`layouts/shortcodes/`, never `themes/hugo-theme-relearn`; `layouts/shortcodes/svg.html` pulls `svg/`. Styling only `assets/css/theme-grafioschtrader.css`; pass-through `static/`; diagrams `svg/`/beside Markdown; refresh `public/`/`resources/` only via `hugo --cleanDestinationDir`. Hugo Extended v0.120+. `#` titles, `##`/`###`, Markdown lists/tables, existing shortcodes; lowercase domain folders/filenames, nearby media.

`hugo server --disableFastRender -D --buildFuture --navigateToChanged`
`hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings --cleanDestinationDir`
`hugo server --renderToDisk --printUnusedTemplates`

Run `hugo --gc --minify --printI18nWarnings` before every commit; today that build is the test suite. Add `--i18n-warnings --printUnusedTranslations --printPathWarnings`. Spot-check `public/search/index.json` and affected HTML in Chromium and Firefox. Include regenerated `public/`; avoid mixing content/layout/CSS. Use focused imperative commits. PRs list touched sections, link issues, attach styling screenshots/zipped `public/`, and state whether `hugo --gc --minify` ran clean.
